subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **share.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"share"** means to have a portion of (something) with another or others. (साझा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **They share their knowledge freely with anyone who is interested.
 
 
 
• **"Share"** is used as a verb in the present tense to indicate the act of sharing. (साझा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **We share our resources to help the community.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that people from many cultures can communicate and exchange ideas because to it.
 
• After **'to',** the **base** form of a **verb **is used.
 
• Out of the given options, the word that must fit the blank should be 'share' (base form of verb).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sharing **(साझा करना): The act of using something jointly with others.

 
 
• **Example:** Sharing is an important value in our community.
 
 
 
• **Shares **(साझा करता है): Third person singular present form of "share."
 
 
• **Example: **He shares his tools with his neighbors.
 
 
 
• **Shared** (साझा किया): Past tense of "share."
 
 
• **Example:** They shared their food with the hungry.
